items.headline: Northwestern safety Jon Jon Stevens exits in second half with upper-body injury
items.description: Northwestern starting safety Jon Jon Stevens was carted off the field in the third quarter at Oregon on Saturday after delivering a hard blow on a tackle, and the team later announced he was being evaluated in the locker room for an upper-body injury.
